summary.text: Stacey Pendergraft is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 70, in the November 3, 2026 general election; incumbent Republican Carl R. Albrecht and Zeno Parry of the Utah Forward Party are also on the ballot.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Pendergraft said she has worked with adults with disabilities for nearly 17 years.

paragraphs.text: Pendergraft earned a high school diploma from Moreno Valley High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Pendergraft described herself as a progressive Democrat and said that after supporting her father through cancer she redirected her career toward caring for people.
Pendergraft named affordability, veterans' care, education and health care for all as her policy interests, and said she wants to sponsor legislation to keep veterans in Utah housed and healthy.
She listed an endorsement from the Sevier County Utah Democratic Party.
